oracle.harness: tcp_oracle.c + build.sh + run-goldens.sh (kept off the repository, R14)
oracle.stubs: tcpapi_send, tcpapi_close, tcpapi_recv, tcpapi_set_timeout, tcpapi_reconnect, tcpapi_change_app_state record their calls; output_report_banner, syn_cookie, default_udp_parse, pcapfile_*, preprocess_frame abort if called (banner1_parse never reaches them)
oracle.calls: banner1_create once; per run a zeroed StreamState with the case's port, banout_init, banner1_parse per piece (whole stream, every byte, the given segments), then the records banner_flush reports (list order, length && protocol, app = protocol & 0x0FFFFFFF); each run in a forked child with a 2-second alarm

expected: rmasscan banner_stream on the whole stream, byte by byte, the given segments and 8 random splits: records (each C record cut at 65 536 bytes, R5) and app_proto equal C's whole run for expect=records, actions too on the whole stream; app_proto only for expect=classification; for expect=declared-4b the named 4b rule (unknown-stream: the whole stream as one unknown record) and C's app_proto
